text:
miriam: quick postmortem follow-up from last night's KV-cache OOM on prod-shard-3. Root cause looks like unbounded pinned pages from long-lived batched requests. Putting proposed action items + owners below — please ack and add ETA.

aj: ack. I'll take the allocation profile + reproducer.

sasha: will take GC tuning + slab allocator parameter audit. Need a safe canary plan.

denver: I'll add runtime guardrails: per-shard pinned-entry cap + emergency eviction switch. Will draft PR.

miriam: owners assigned: aj (profiling & repro), sasha (GC & allocator), denver (guards & rollout). Please add concrete timelines by EOD Fri.

aj: starting with perftrace, quick repro steps below:
```
# reproduce at scale (local-ish)
$ stress-client --concurrency 300 --stream-duration 60s --endpoint https://prod.redwood/api/generate --payload heavy_stream.json
```

aj: initial heap profile shows repeated ~32MB pinned buffers coming from kv::ShardCache::pin() retaining after response complete. Instrumenting pin/unpin paths now.

sasha: proposed GC knob changes: lower slab-grow-threshold 0.8 -> 0.6, and add an aggressive young-gen trim cycle after 5000 requests. Will bench on staging.

denver: guardrail config proposal: `kv.max_pinned_per_shard = 50`, `kv.emergency_evict = true` (feature flag). Plan: land as behind-flag hotfix, enable in canary, then progressive rollout.

miriam: timeline check — can we get a canary for the guardrail by Mon 03:00 UTC? If so we'll roll to 10% traffic and monitor for OOM regressions.

denver: yes, canary Mon 03:00 UTC -> 10% traffic. I'll prepare PR and runbook blurb for oncall.

sasha: @qa-team can you schedule mem-pressure regression run against the canary? Need to validate latency and memory under sustained pinning. :pray: 

qa-bot: scheduled mem-pressure test for Mon 02:30 UTC against canary deployment (job #mmr-195555).

aj: I'll add a CI regression that simulates pinned buffers and fails if leaked > 100MB in 5 minutes.

miriam: also updating the incidents runbook: new section "kv-pinned-pages" with detection, temporary mitigations (flip emergency_evict, reduce concurrency), and long-term remediation checklist. I'll open the runbook PR.

aj: note — seen a recurring pattern across last 3 incidents: fragmentation spikes after background compaction runs, which delays reclamation and increases pinned buffer lifetime. We should add compaction-awareness to eviction heuristics.

sasha: agree. I'll add a fragmentation metric to dashboards (kv.fragmentation_pct) and create an alert: fragmentation_pct > 30 for 10m.

denver: PRs in flight: #4821 (guardrail + feature flag), #4823 (emergency_evict CLI), sasha will post GC tuning PR after perf numbers. aj will post profiling doc link.

miriam: excellent. Action owners: update this thread when PRs land, when canary starts, and when QA completes tests. I'll prepare an exec summary for Wed.

sasha: ack :white_check_mark:

aj: ack, starting now, will post profile dump link when available.

denver: ack. I'll include rollout playbook and rollback steps in the PR description.

miriam: thanks everyone — this keeps things measurable. We'll reconvene next Tue for outcomes and long-term plan.
